t: Offline: the web app opens without signal and saves notes on your phone; they sync when you're back online ("Back online · syncing").

Related ideas: every star now shows its 5 most related stars that aren't linked yet; tap one to open it, or + to link it (your notes).
Mic: switches off completely after each answer and whenever you leave or close the app; tap the mic for the next question.

Ask and Talk now research the web by default (Perplexity Sonar via Puter, with sources). Your notes are used when you mention them ("my notes", "my brain"). Lessons stay on Claude so progress tracking keeps working.
